rows: each entry's rows are the episodes of the run record it names, reduced to the fields the experiment reports: agent, seed, lines, score, frames, pieces_placed, stopping_reason and clear_sizes
what_it_is: the distilled per-episode rows of every ten-seed evaluation run the retained result supersedes, copied out of the ignored run records they came from (runs/ is disposable output), so the refactor_no_outcomes_changed comparison is made against a retained artifact rather than against a run directory a later checkout need not have
